description: footRoll 20 is under the 30 degree break, so the ball takes all of it: +20 about the toe pivot. y' = 0.7 cos20 + 1.8 sin20 = 1.273421, z' = 0.7 sin20 - 1.8 cos20 = -1.452033. The toe pivot is the toe joint (4, 3.3, 1.8), so the hand at (4, 4, 0) is offset (dy 0.7, dz -1.8) from it, the toe bone's length 1.931321, and it keeps that length to the planted toe. The Limb is at IK, so its hand reaches the foot's ankle target.
